In short

Hunger relief team building rallies your people around fighting food insecurity. Legendary Team Building’s strongest fit is 60 Seconds to Give, a give-back game show where teams race quick challenges and every win triggers a real donation to the causes your company chooses — including food banks and hunger-relief organizations. In Operation You Matter, teams pack essentials kits for families leaving a shelter or crisis. For groups of 5 to 5,000, since 2003, with a measurable CSR impact you can report. Part of our charity & CSR team building.

An honest note on format

We’re a build-and-give company, not a meal-packing line. If you specifically want a meal-assembly event, tell us and we’ll be honest about whether we’re the right fit. Where Legendary Team Building shines on hunger is funding the food banks you choose through 60 Seconds to Give and packing family essentials in Operation You Matter — hands-on giving your people remember, with donation totals you can report.

The program

60 Seconds to Give: fund the fight against hunger.

Teams race fast, 60-second challenges in a high-energy game show. Every win triggers a real donation to the causes your company chooses up front — point them at local food banks and hunger-relief organizations, and your team literally plays to feed families.

  • ✓60 to 90 minutes, for 25 to 500 players per show.
  • ✓Your company picks the causes and the donation amounts up front — food banks included.
  • ✓We bring everything — the show, the crew, setup and teardown.
Explore 60 Seconds to Give →

How a hunger relief give-back works

  1. Pick the cause. You choose the food banks or hunger-relief organizations up front; Legendary Team Building confirms them.
  2. Play or pack. Teams compete in 60 Seconds to Give, or pack family essentials kits in Operation You Matter.
  3. Trigger the giving. In 60 Seconds to Give, every win releases a real donation to your chosen causes.
  4. The impact lands. Donations reach the food banks; essentials kits reach families rebuilding.
  5. Report it. You receive participation numbers and donation totals for CSR and ESG reporting.
The reason it sticks

Your people will remember playing to feed families.

That’s the point. Channel your team’s energy into a cause in their own community and the bond — and the lesson — lasts. We’ve run give-back events since 2003 and produced the Guinness World Record–setting charity bike build for our client DaVita.

Questions, answered

Hunger relief give-back FAQs

What is hunger relief team building? +

A corporate give-back that channels your team’s energy into fighting food insecurity. With Legendary Team Building, teams compete in 60 Seconds to Give — where every win triggers a real donation to food banks and hunger-relief groups your company chooses — or pack family essentials kits in Operation You Matter, for groups of 5 to 5,000.

Do you offer meal-packing events? +

Legendary Team Building is a build-and-give company rather than a meal-assembly line. If you specifically need a meal-packing event, tell us and we’ll be honest about fit. Where we excel on hunger is funding the food banks you choose through 60 Seconds to Give and packing family essentials in Operation You Matter.

How does the donation to food banks work? +

In 60 Seconds to Give, your company picks the causes and donation amounts up front, and every challenge a team wins releases a real donation to those causes — food banks and hunger-relief organizations included.

How big can a hunger relief event be? +

60 Seconds to Give runs for 25 to 500 players per show; Operation You Matter scales from 5 to 5,000. Both run in a standard ballroom or meeting room.

How much does a hunger relief team building event cost? +

Legendary Team Building’s give-back programs run $50 to $225 per person, including facilitation, all materials, the donation and the crew. Groups over 1,000 are custom-priced.

Can a hunger relief give-back support our CSR and ESG reporting? +

Yes. Participation numbers and donation totals, packaged into an ESG-ready impact report.
